canonical_project: RackForest / Rackhost Data Center (Victor Hugo utca)
notes: Rendszerinformatika's official Victor Hugo datacenter page lists 1132 Budapest, Victor Hugo 18-22, 70 rack spaces, 270 sqm gross, 3 kW per rack (~0.21 MW). RackForest's official service page states georedundancy across 5 server rooms and 3 Budapest locations. Commercial hosting/colocation.
